output.title: ClusterIssuer `ciss` short name is additive and unused here
output.content: The change only adds a `ciss` short name for the ClusterIssuer resource, which is an additive convenience alias and does not alter existing behavior. The environment summary shows only a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifest and the installed CRD certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]. No ClusterIssuer manifest or CRD appears in the summary, and the values keys (replicaCount, prometheus.servicemonitor.*, global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole) are unrelated. The only exposure would be an existing script or alias that already uses `ciss` for something else, and the evidence says nothing about that.
